theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Ares Fund Offering Hit by Australia Crackdown on Private Credit
top_news.summary: Australia’s securities regulator temporarily barred asset manager Fidante Partners Ltd. from offering units in a fund it runs with Ares Management Corp., as authorities expand a clampdown on private credit over risks to retail investors.

top_news.title: Stocks Extend Losses as AI Trade Under Pressure: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A selloff in technology stocks on Wall Street extended into Asia, with losses in the artificial intelligence trade — one of the market’s hottest corners this year. Oil declined.

top_news.title: Goldman Says Market Is Underestimating How Far Yuan Can Rise
top_news.summary: A stronger yuan is among the most underpriced scenarios in the world’s $9.5 trillion-a-day foreign exchange market, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.’s Kamakshya Trivedi.

top_news.title: Chip Selloff Triggers 6% Korea Rout After CEO’s ‘Casino’ Warning
top_news.summary: A global slide in semiconductor stocks deepened, sending South Korea’s chip-heavy market down more than 6% as concerns about Chinese competition and stretched AI valuations intensified.

top_news.title: Pakistan Targets Growth of More Than 4% for 2026
top_news.summary: Pakistani Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb discusses the country's financing needs and economic growth outlook. He speaks with Avril Hong on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok. (Corrects event’s location in video description.) (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: BNY's LaRusse Sees Scope for Bond Market Relief Rally
top_news.summary: April LaRusse, co-head of global client portfolio management at BNY Investments, says it is too early to confidently call a peak in Treasury yields. Speaking on "The Asia Trade," LaRusse says current market pricing for roughly three rate hikes looks excessive, leaving room for a relief rally if the Middle East conflict eases or labor market data weakens. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 13
top_news.summary: Oil edged lower following three days of gains that were driven by concern the widening war in the Middle East could hamper a recovery in supply from the region.

top_news.title: Hong Kong Lifeline Buys Cheng Family Time to Save New World
top_news.summary: It was a Wednesday evening in late September and analysts covering New World Development Co. were getting antsy. The cash-strapped Hong Kong developer was late to report its earnings, and executives hadn’t shown up to a scheduled briefing.

top_news.title: Katrina Dudley on AI Spending and ROI
top_news.summary: Katrina Dudley, Franklin Templeton public market senior investment strategist discusses spending in AI and what the ROI could look like. She speaks with Dani Burger on “Open Interest.” (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Albertsons Seeks More Than $9 Billion for Busted Kroger Deal
top_news.summary: Albertsons Cos. is demanding that Kroger Co. pay more than $9 billion for the collapse of what would have been the largest US grocery chain merger in history.
